segments: The book of Deuteronomy, chapter
28:49. The Lord shall bring a nation
against thee from far, from the end of
the earth, as swift as the eaglefly, a
nation whose tongue thou shalt not
understand. Whether it was northern
kingdom with Christopher Columbus in
1492 or southern kingdom in 1619, the
eagle was the sign of the heathen nation
Edom. Whether it was Latin, Portuguese
or English, we spoke Hebrew. The book of
Oadia
1:3. The pride of thy heart have
deceived thee. Thou who dwellest in the
cliffs of the rock. So the Edomite
nation Edom, they always dwelt in the
cliffs of the rocks. And that's their
sign showing that they are the
Neanderthal. They are the ones that love
the habitation that was driven into
Mount Sea that said in thy heart, who
shall bring me down to the ground?
That's them having that pride on them
dealing with battle and dealing with
them conquering other nations. Verse
four, though thou exalt thyself as the
eagle, and set thy nest among the stars,
then will I bring thee down, sayeth the
Lord. The eagle landed. So once again,
we see the eagle. For the Lord is proven
that Esau Eden in Deuteronomy
28:49 is Esau. Deuteronomy chapter 28
verse 50. A nation whose fierce copies
which shall not regard the person of old
nor show favor to the young. When we
were in captivity they showed no mercy
to our old women or old men including
our young children. When you look at the
book of Zechariah
11:5, it says, "Whose possessors slay
them and hold themselves not guilty." So
when you look at Esau dealing with
whether is all the way from captivity,
what happened to us, dealing with
critical race theory all the way till
now, whether it's shooting my brothers
down in the streets, murdering our
people, they hold themselves not guilty.
Continue. It says, "And they that sell
them say, blessed be the Lord God, for I
am rich, and their own shepherds penny
them not." So, it's showing on what in
these last days, Esau says that once he
has the children of Israel in his
possession, and even our Lord has
forgotten us, but the Lord has not
forgotten us. We must repent.
